messages.author: ac421cf36d1a4c37
messages.subject: Re: Model not converging
parts: Your model does not appear to be identified. All the indicators of F3 are also indicators of F2. A good rule of thumb is that each factor should have at least a partially nonoverlapping set of indicators.
